Sandbox_SFL_Enabled_tooltip: Disabling this prevents new batches. Sealed batches continue.

Sandbox_SFL_BaseCapacity_tooltip: Default 4, range 1–30. Applied only once to each new lunchbox. Existing boxes, upgrades and original-stat restoration are never overwritten by later sandbox changes.

Sandbox_SFL_BatchHours_tooltip: Default 12, range 0.25–24. Each batch keeps the duration selected at the start.
